findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：公司稱營收成長來自市占提升（銷售團隊、品項廣度、收購、新配送中心）。
findings.excerpt: Through these efforts, we believe that we have been able to expand our customer base, enhance and diversify our product selections, broaden our geographic penetration and increase our market share.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：客戶轉換成本極低、進入門檻低、無獨家合約，競爭可能導致降價與市占流失。
findings.excerpt: The cost of switching distributors is very low, as are the barriers to entry into the U.S. foodservice distribution industry.

findings.claim: 10-K：競爭對手含大量在地小型配送商與少數全國性綜合配送商，部分資源較公司雄厚；未點名具體新進入者。
findings.excerpt: We compete with numerous smaller distributors on a local level, as well as with a limited number of national broadline foodservice distributors. Certain of these distributors have greater financial and other resources than we do.

findings.claim: 2026 Q2（2026年7月）公司稱銷售與淨利雙位數成長，來自訂單量、新客戶與北美市占持續提升（媒體轉述公司說法，無第三方份額數據）。
